<thought>To determine the number of methyl groups, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample. Methyl groups appear as singlets (or sometimes doublets/triplets) around 0.8‑1.2 ppm with integration corresponding to three protons. By analyzing the spectrum I can count how many distinct methyl signals are present.</thought>
